operator: Shenyang Hunnan Modern Transport Co., Ltd. — Hunnan Modern Tram (沈阳浑南现代有轨电车)
notes:
Tram feed (route_type=0) for the Shenyang Hunnan Modern Tramway (opened 2013-08-15; JV Shenyang Hunnan Modern Transport 51% / RATP Dev Transdev Asia 49%). Covers the three currently-operating lines: Line 1 (Xinglong Outlets–Expo Centre, 23 stops), Line 3 (Expo Centre–Century Tower, 11 stops), Line 5 (Olympic Centre–Shenfu Xincheng, 23 stops). Lines 2, 4 and 6 are EXCLUDED because they were suspended/closed (Line 2 & 4 on 2024-10-25/28; Line 6 in 2020).

STOPS: 55 unique stations, all WGS-84 coordinates pulled from OpenStreetMap (Overpass, railway=tram_stop nodes in the Hunnan bbox) — NOT from Amap/Baidu (GCJ-02), per the CN guidance. Line 5 ordered sequence came directly from OSM route relation 6059624 with exact 0 m coordinate matches to named stops. Lines 1 and 3 sequences were derived by projecting named tram_stop nodes onto OSM route relations 17703081 / 17703075 (stops within 60 m of the polyline, ordered by distance-along; Line 1's northern segment re-oriented so the Xinglong Outlets terminus is first). Stop names are kept in Chinese (with English where OSM provided name:en). Line 1 and Line 3 share stops 会展中心/东北大学 and Line 1↔Line 5 share 奥体中心-area interchange; shared stations are single stop records reused across routes.

SCHEDULE: Real published data used where available — Line 5 first/last ≈ Olympic Centre 06:30–22:00, Shenfu Xincheng 05:30–21:00, peak headway 15 min; Lines 1/2/3 peak headway 16 min (Shenyang Bendibao / Shenyangbus). No per-stop timetable is published, so within-trip times are modeled at an even ~2.5 min inter-stop spacing (~28 km/h incl. dwell). Only representative trips are emitted (first, AM-peak ~08:40, midday ~12:40, PM-peak ~17:28, last ~22:00 per direction) rather than the full even-headway expansion, to keep the feed compact while faithful to span and ordering. Service modeled as daily (calendar Mon–Sun).

CONFIDENCE 0.62: stops, coordinates, ordering and line termini are well-evidenced (OSM + Wikipedia); headways and operating span are from secondary/older Chinese transit pages and line adjustments (some 2019–2024 construction reroutings) may mean current service differs; per-stop clock times are modeled, not published. Feed passes referential-integrity validation (all 570 stop_times reference valid trips/stops; every trip monotonic in time; all 55 stops referenced). English station names are transliterations/OSM-provided and approximate.

Sources: en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shenyang_Modern_Tram; en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Trams_in_Shenyang; OpenStreetMap Overpass (route=tram relations 6059624/17703081/17703075 + railway=tram_stop nodes); sy.bendibao.com and shenyangbus.com (operating hours/headways); www.syygdc.com (operator).
